dedupe_keys.name: eu farm sustainability data network fsdn formerly fadn

description: The Farm Sustainability Data Network is the European Union's annual survey of farms and the only source of microeconomic data on EU commercial farms based on harmonised bookkeeping principles. For more than 60 years it has collected farm economics data from a sample of about 75,000 farms that represent 3.5 million farms and 90 per cent of EU agricultural production, with representative results by region, economic size and type of farming. It is managed nationally and compiled at EU level, and from 2025 it began adding data on environmental and social sustainability to income and business information. The FSDN public database aggregates validated individual data into standard results, with annual economic farming data at EU level and by country and farm economy data by sector, and access to these standard results tables is free online. No licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: only commercial farms above national size thresholds are sampled, and results are averages for groups of farms. For simulation it gives farm income, costs and structure by region and farm type for agricultural loss, resilience and policy scenarios. Related catalogue records include Eurostat LUCAS and FAOSTAT.
